about: 잔액조정입력(E010209) · 잔액실사조회(E010211) · 잔액조정조회(E010210) · 잔액조정현황(E010212) — 원본 2026-10-14 loginaa 실측과 같은 흐름: 기준일자 전월 말일 · [조정] → '잔액실사(계정별)' → 안 고치고 저장 '변경된정보가 없습니다.' → 부서 없음 줄 실잔액 = 장부 + 11,000 · 적요 QA회계1 잔액조정(조정금액 −11,000) → 저장(안내 없이 닫힘) → 차변금액 +11,000 · 진행단계 [수정 · 추가 · 조회] → 시산표 811 차변만 +11,000(한쪽 전표) → 실사조회 · 조회 · 현황에 한 줄씩(차이(차변) 11,000) → [선택삭제] '선택한 전표를 삭제 하겠습니까?' → 잔액 · 시산표 되돌림. 원본 8109 는 우리 811. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/balance-adjust.json

shots.name: 잔액조정입력 — 조정 · 저장 · 잔액
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = new Date(); const e = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), 0); const asOf = e.getFullYear() + '-' + String(e.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(e.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const tb = await (await fetch('/api/journals/trial-balance?from=' + asOf + '&to=' + asOf, { headers: H })).json(); const r = tb.rows.find((x) => x.accountCode === '8109') || { debit: 0, credit: 0 }; const acc = (await (await fetch('/api/journals/balance-adjustments/accounts?asOf=' + asOf, { headers: H })).json()).find((x) => x.code === '8109'); sessionStorage.setItem('ba-base', JSON.stringify({ asOf, d811: Number(r.debit), c811: Number(r.credit), bal: Number(acc.debitAmount), tbd: Number(tb.totalDebit), tbc: Number(tb.totalCredit) })); return sessionStorage.getItem('ba-base') })()

js:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.cells[1]?.innerText.trim() === '8109'); [...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.innerText.trim() === '조정').click(); return true })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const row = document.querySelector('[aria-label="1 실잔액"]').closest('tr'); const book = Number(row.cells[3].innerText.replace(/,/g, '') || 0); sessionStorage.setItem('ba-book', String(book)); set(document.querySelector('[aria-label="1 실잔액"]'), String(book + 11000)); set(document.querySelector('[aria-label="1 적요명"]'), 'QA회계1 잔액조정'); return 'book ' + book })()

expect:(() => { const b = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('ba-base')); const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.cells[1]?.innerText.trim() === '8109'); return Number(tr.cells[4].innerText.replace(/,/g, '')) === b.bal + 11000 && tr.cells[6].innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() === '수정 추가 조회' })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const b = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('ba-base')); const tb = await (await fetch('/api/journals/trial-balance?from=' + b.asOf + '&to=' + b.asOf, { headers: H })).json(); const r = tb.rows.find((x) => x.accountCode === '8109'); return Number(r.debit) === b.d811 + 11000 && Number(r.credit) === b.c811 && Number(tb.totalDebit) === b.tbd + 11000 && Number(tb.totalCredit) === b.tbc })()

shots.name: 잔액실사조회 — 한 줄
steps: expect:(() => { const book = Number(sessionStorage.getItem('ba-book')); const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.cells[3]?.innerText.trim().startsWith('복리후생비')); return !!tr && tr.cells[1].innerText.trim() === '계정별' && Number(tr.cells[4].innerText.replace(/,/g, '')) === book && Number(tr.cells[5].innerText.replace(/,/g, '')) === book + 11000 && / -\d+$/.test(tr.cells[6].innerText.trim()) })()

shots.name: 잔액조정현황 — 차이(차변) 11,000
steps: expect:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.cells[8]?.innerText.trim() === 'QA회계1 잔액조정'); return !!tr && tr.cells[1].innerText.trim() === '8109' && tr.cells[6].innerText.trim() === '11,000' && [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].some((t) => / 계$/.test(t.cells[0]?.innerText.trim() ?? '')) && document.querySelector('tfoot').innerText.includes('합계') })()

shots.name: 잔액조정조회 — 선택삭제 → 되돌림
steps: js:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.cells[2]?.innerText.trim().startsWith('복리후생비') && /^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2} -\d+$/.test(t.cells[1].innerText.trim())); tr.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').click(); return tr.cells[1].innerText })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const b = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('ba-base')); const tb = await (await fetch('/api/journals/trial-balance?from=' + b.asOf + '&to=' + b.asOf, { headers: H })).json(); const r = tb.rows.find((x) => x.accountCode === '8109') || { debit: 0, credit: 0 }; const acc = (await (await fetch('/api/journals/balance-adjustments/accounts?asOf=' + b.asOf, { headers: H })).json()).find((x) => x.code === '8109'); return Number(r.debit) === b.d811 && Number(tb.totalDebit) === b.tbd && Number(acc.debitAmount) === b.bal && acc.adjustmentIds.length === 0 })()

shots.name: 자동생성전표조회 — 신규(F2) 입력년월 → 알림
steps: expect:document.body.innerText.includes('선택된 연월에 대체분개시점이 유효한 자동대체가 존재하지 않습니다.')
